items.title: Allen Toussaint Interview, 1979-03-13
items.q: And there was an album during the feeling time with Wardell. Because they went in with him. And it was really nice.

ctx.x: Well, I didn't mean that. The Neville brothers is the band, but I should have said it's the individuals. And specifically with the album that supposedly Aaron Neville cut here for Island Records. I think it was going to be called Feelings. Was there an album produced here that is unreleased by him?

Yes. I didn't go in with them. By that time, I wasn't working with Aaron anymore. In fact, back during the days of Hercules is the last time I actually worked with Aaron. And there was an album during the feeling time with Wardell. Because they went in with him. And it was really nice. I don't know exactly what became of it. But, yes, there was an album.
So it's just unreleased. Is Island probably on the rights to it? I guess so. Could you conceive of working with them again? Them being her? Well, either as the Neville brothers or as individuals.
